request.query: A finite sum strictly decreases if one summand is strictly smaller

items.name: Finset.sum_erase_lt_of_pos
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_5} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid κ] [inst_2 : LT κ] [AddLeftStrictMono κ]
  {s : Finset ι} {d : ι}, d ∈ s → ∀ {f : ι → κ}, 0 < f d → ∑ m ∈ s.erase d, f m < ∑ m ∈ s, f m

items.name: Finset.sum_lt_sum
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid M]
  {f g : ι → M} {s : Finset ι}, (∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i) → (∃ i ∈ s, f i < g i) → ∑ i ∈ s, f i < ∑ i ∈ s, g i

items.name: ENNReal.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {s : Finset α}, s.Nonempty → ∀ {f g : α → ENNReal}, (∀ i ∈ s, f i < g i) → ∑ i ∈ s, f i < ∑ i ∈ s, g i

items.name: List.sum_lt_sum
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddMonoid M] [inst_1 : Preorder M] [AddLeftStrictMono M] [AddLeftMono M]
  [AddRightStrictMono M] [AddRightMono M] {l : List ι} (f g : ι → M),
  (∀ (i : ι), i ∈ l → f i ≤ g i) → (∃ i, i ∈ l ∧ f i < g i) → (List.map f l).sum < (List.map g l).sum

items.name: Finset.single_lt_sum
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid M]
  {f : ι → M} {s : Finset ι} {i j : ι},
  j ≠ i → i ∈ s → j ∈ s → 0 < f j → (∀ k ∈ s, k ≠ i → 0 ≤ f k) → f i < ∑ k ∈ s, f k
